comment: glyphs.c parse_id() for S_* object-class entries, listed by wiz_custom(): find_oc's value is the entry's loadsyms offset, one less than its class, and glyph_find_core() matches glyph_to_obj(), so Enhanced2's S_amulet Unicode lands on the generic ring glyphs, an rc glyph:S_strange_obj on the strange object glyphs, and glyph:S_venom on the generic iron chain glyphs. Seed, date and character chosen independently.
